branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: A Gouda-type cheese with a name of its own, made exclusively for the Albert Heijn supermarket chain since 1919. It is sold at different ages, from young to old, and also as a cumin cheese (komijnekaas).

sources.text: Exclusive supply to Albert Heijn since 1919, the ages and the cumin variant, from this article.
